items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: I started in the Red Lake District. That was Frankie Haney on piano, Manuel Perez playing cornet. I was playing violin.

ctx.x: Was that a dance band or a brass band?

Yes, a regular orchestra. It started with him. I stayed with him until I got better, and I moved from there and went further around town in New Orleans, you know, another neighborhood. Got acquainted with a lot of the upper musicians. Going with one band this night, another one, playing in with the band, taking my violin with me, and playing in with the other fellas, you see. That's what brought me on through with my music. Just might as well say I stole it. You know how they... That was wonderful. And by some…
